faqs.question: How can I take admission?
faqs.answer: You can visit any Shital Academy branch or contact the academy directly to receive admission guidance and complete the enrollment process.

faqs.question: How do I choose the right course?
faqs.answer: Our counselors help students choose a suitable course based on their education, career goals, and current skill level.

faqs.question: Do you provide demo lectures?
faqs.answer: Please contact the academy to know whether demo lectures are currently available.

faqs.question: How can I know the course fees?
faqs.answer: Course fees vary depending on the selected course. Please contact the academy for the latest fee details.

faqs.question: What payment options are available?
faqs.answer: Please contact the academy to know the currently accepted payment methods.

faqs.question: How long are the courses?
faqs.answer: Course duration varies depending on the selected program.

faqs.question: Are flexible batches available?
faqs.answer: Yes. Flexible batch timings are available for most courses.

faqs.question: Do you provide study material?
faqs.answer: Yes. Study material is provided according to the course requirements.

faqs.question: How are the faculty members?
faqs.answer: The academy has qualified, experienced, patient, and supportive faculty members who provide personalized guidance.

faqs.question: Do you provide certificates?
faqs.answer: Please contact the academy for information about certificate availability for your selected course.

faqs.question: Do you provide placement support?
faqs.answer: Please contact the academy to know the placement support available for your chosen course.

faqs.question: Are online classes available?
faqs.answer: Please contact the academy to know whether online classes are available for your preferred course.

faqs.question: Are offline classes available?
faqs.answer: Yes. Courses are primarily conducted through offline classroom training.

faqs.question: How many branches does Shital Academy have?
faqs.answer: Shital Academy has multiple branches. Please ask for a specific branch or check the contact information.

faqs.question: How can I contact the academy?
faqs.answer: You can contact the academy using the phone numbers, email addresses, or branch contact details provided by Shital Academy.

faqs.question: Is parking available?
faqs.answer: Please contact the respective branch for parking availability.

faqs.question: Is there any age limit?
faqs.answer: Most courses are open to learners of different age groups. Please contact the academy for course-specific eligibility.

faqs.question: Do students receive individual attention?
faqs.answer: Yes. The academy follows a personalized teaching approach with individual attention.

faqs.question: In which language are classes conducted?
faqs.answer: Please contact the academy for the language of instruction for your selected course.

faqs.question: What are the academy holidays?
faqs.answer: Please contact your branch for the latest holiday schedule.
